(a) To maintain steady energy levels throughout the day, you may wish to opt for snacks combining protein, fibre, and healthy fats—such as whole-grain crackers with cheese, apple slices with peanut butter, or a small portion of mixed nuts. These help sustain focus and prevent mid-afternoon energy slumps.
(b) Given your preference for high-protein diets, you may wish to opt for snacks that deliver sustained energy through lean protein—such as a boiled egg with a sprinkle of pepper, cottage cheese with cucumber slices, or edamame beans. These choices support satiety and help maintain mental alertness throughout the day.
(c) Given your family history of type 2 diabetes, you may wish to opt for snacks that are low in refined sugars and rich in fibre to maintain steady energy levels—such as a small handful of unsalted nuts, carrot sticks with hummus, or plain Greek yoghurt with berries. These choices provide slow-release carbohydrates and healthy fats, helping to avoid sharp glucose spikes.
(d) Given the East Asian culinary influences you may enjoy, you may wish to opt for snacks that balance flavour and nutrition—such as a small sushi roll with brown rice, edamame pods lightly sprinkled with sea salt, or sliced pear with a few almonds. These provide steady energy without excessive sugar or saturated fat.
